notes.title: Update notes - July 2
notes.notes:
Hello guys!

We’re still hard at work on Captain Firehawk, our very first title, and the one we’ve always dreamed of creating. We're fully committed and won’t give up on it! 💛

Right now, we’re focusing on key systems to ensure a solid and consistent experience. We're also constantly listening to our amazing community and doing everything we can to improve the game.

Thank you all for your continued support!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42864193/f769a4d43f6ce2000df3baa69616dc25548a2dd3.gif"]

Release Notes:

Version update

Improved controller support

Preventive fixes for save system bugs

Preventive fixes for Steam integration bugs

Object tracking bug fixes

General performance improvements

Minor asset updates.

notes.title: Development update
notes.notes:
Hello! We are here giving a general update on what has been done so far the last 8 months on the project. We are in intense work activity regarding the game, we decided not to let the quality drop and continue developing the project as a way to make a dream come true and that has been our tone until now.

What we have in numbers:


Script 97% complete

Stage 0 - Status: Complete
Stage 1 - Status: Complete
Stage 2 - Status: Complete
Stage 3 - Status: 80%
Stage 4 - Status: 80%
Stage 5 - Status: 70%
Stage 6 - Status: 70%
Stage 7 - Status: 60% - SPECIAL MISSION (backers edition only)

22 songs - 100%

Puzzle Box 0 60%
Puzzle Box 1 60%
Puzzle Box 2 60%
Puzzle Box 3 60%
Puzzle Box 4 60%
Puzzle Box 5 60%
Puzzle Box 6 60%
Puzzle Box 7 60%

Storytelling Static-Animations 90 of 170


The team is very small (just the two of us) but we have faith that we will have the game ready by the end of October.
